comment: The clearsky window («Польовий КПК», the Clear Sky field PDA): every picture the mockup draws with CSS.
Sizes are layout units; drawn at 1.5 px per unit. White shapes are tinted in the game (the layout's color or SetColor);
the map texture has its own colours, is opaque (composited on --lcd: the game blends in linear light) and is shown with color 1 1 1 1.
icon_gear is the mockup's ICON.gear, the icon its iconOf() falls back to: the skin shows it in a node that has no icon of its own.
The rules are the mockup's own CSS (body[data-f=clearsky] and the base it builds on), lifted into clearsky.css.
The straight bands of the casing and every flat rectangle (the floating panels, their edges and accent corners,
chips, bars, the button) are panels of the layout; only the casing's rounded corners are pictures here.
scan and fog_stripes are pixel tiles: the game repeats a picture shown without stretching at one texel per screen
pixel, so they are drawn at exactly 16 and 32 pixels (w x 1.5 = size).
